The '''Council of Seven Crowns''' was the traditional governing council of the [[United Kingdoms of Belcanto]]. It coordinated foreign policy, trade, defense, succession disputes, and relations among Belcantese regions before Vesperan conquest.

== Role ==

The council allowed Belcantese polities to cooperate without eliminating local autonomy. It was one of the main institutions that helped Belcanto resist outside conquest before the late nineteenth century.

== Dissolution And Legacy ==

After the [[Belcanto Campaign]], Vesperan authorities dissolved traditional federal institutions and replaced them with imperial administration. The council remained important in Belcantese memory because it represented pre-conquest self-rule.

Postwar federalism in the [[Belcanto Nations]] drew on the council's legacy, though the modern state did not simply restore the medieval institution.

== Canon Note ==

The source uses both five-nation and seven-region language. This draft treats the Council of Seven Crowns as a traditional institution whose exact seats need final review before AGGSWorld publication.
